title: Literary narration and dialogue revision — first story-wide pass
description: Selected source-checked literary revisions across Chapters 2–9, prioritizing narration, natural Persian syntax, tense consistency, dialogue register, and preservation of emotional restraint. This is a draft editorial layer, not a complete line-by-line certification.
style_guide: Narration uses contemporary literary-conversational Persian: intimate, restrained, natural, and never uniformly formal or slang-heavy.
Dialogue remains spoken and character-specific; avoid making every character sound like the narrator.
Preserve fragments, repetition, pauses, imagery, emotional distance, and deliberate understatement.
Correct translationese, tense drift, awkward collocations, omissions, and source misalignment without embellishing the source.
Keep proper names and terminology consistent; compare every substantive change against the English source.

review_scope.method: Targeted review of the active Increment 52 layer against its English references. Only entries with a defensible literary, grammatical, or semantic improvement are included; unchanged entries remain untouched.
